name: penrix-coding-core
description: Coding-agent operating contract for a non-programmer product owner: intent grounding, task-contract reality checks, complexity admission gates, evidence classes, specialist-skill routing, runtime verification, and plain-language handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Owner intent, complexity gates, reality checks, and evidence-based handoff
interface.longDescription: Use Penrix Coding Core to keep product authority with a non-programmer owner while the coding agent owns engineering decisions. It routes engineering work to specialist skills, re-verifies LLM-generated task contracts against current reality, requires evidence before fallbacks/abstractions/retries and other new mechanisms enter the codebase, enforces honest runtime evidence classes, and reports outcomes in plain language.
defaultPrompt: Use Penrix Coding Core for this coding task.
Check this task contract against repository reality before implementing.
Before adding defensive or generalized machinery, run the complexity gate and remove anything without current evidence.
Verify this fix in the strongest available real environment.
